answer: Agents stake bonded jade tokens to register, and each rendezvous burn must submit a signed delta of its orbital state vector so pseudonymous clones cannot share one physical thruster history. A collision-avoidance ledger cross-checks those deltas against docking corridors, forcing any sybil fleet to forge distinct maneuver proofs at real propellant cost. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
